name: Model Selection Heuristic Registry
summary: Family-local interpretation of shared heuristics for deterministic ML model selection pipelines.

family_notes: Selects between OLS, Ridge, Lasso, and ElasticNet based on condition number, n/p ratio, and mutual incoherence.
When the irrepresentable condition is violated, Lasso is unreliable and ElasticNet or Ridge should be preferred.
admissibility_notes: Use condition number and mutual incoherence as hard gates before committing to a regularization strategy.
escalation_conditions: Escalate when condition number exceeds 1e6 (numerically singular).
uncertainty_notes: Mutual incoherence boundary is sharp for Gaussian ensembles but approximate for real data.

references.title: Hoerl & Kennard (1970)
references.note: Ridge regularization for ill-conditioned design matrices.

family_notes: Selects between squared_error, huber, and absolute_error based on residual and target kurtosis.
Heavy-tailed residuals require robust loss to prevent outlier domination.
admissibility_notes: Check residual kurtosis rather than target kurtosis alone for more accurate loss selection.
escalation_conditions: Escalate when residuals are bimodal rather than simply heavy-tailed.
uncertainty_notes: Kurtosis threshold is empirical; exact boundary varies by domain.

family_notes: Selects between Gaussian, Poisson, Gamma, and Tweedie regressors plus appropriate solver.
Dispersion index and Tweedie power parameter determine the exponential family.
admissibility_notes: Validate that target is non-negative before recommending Poisson/Gamma/Tweedie.
uncertainty_notes: Tweedie power estimation via binning is approximate.

family_notes: Selects between HistGradientBoosting, RandomForest, and GradientBoosting.
High noise favors bagging (variance reduction); low noise favors boosting (bias reduction).
admissibility_notes: Noise level estimation via shallow tree is a rough proxy.
escalation_conditions: Escalate when categorical cardinality is extreme (> 1000 unique values).
uncertainty_notes: Noise threshold between bagging and boosting is soft.

family_notes: Recommends scaling, power transforms, and feature removal based on skewness, VIF, and sparsity.
Sparse matrices must avoid mean centering to prevent memory exhaustion.
admissibility_notes: VIF > 10 is a hard signal for feature removal or dimensionality reduction.
escalation_conditions: Escalate when all features exceed VIF > 10 (total multicollinearity).
uncertainty_notes: Skewness threshold is conventional; some models tolerate skew well.

family_notes: Selects between PCA, TruncatedSVD, and no reduction based on condition number and sparsity.
PCA eliminates multicollinearity by producing orthogonal components.
admissibility_notes: TruncatedSVD is mandatory for sparse matrices.
escalation_conditions: Escalate when data lies on a nonlinear manifold (PCA collapses classes).
uncertainty_notes: Explained variance threshold is conventional (0.95 default).

family_notes: Generates intelligent search grids based on model type and data dimensions.
Alpha grids are log-spaced with a hard floor at 1e-5 to prevent zero-regularization collapse.
admissibility_notes: Never set alpha=0; enforce hard floor.
escalation_conditions: Escalate when optimal hyperparameters sit at grid boundaries.
uncertainty_notes: Grid ranges are heuristic starting points, not guarantees.

family_notes: Selects between KFold, StratifiedKFold, TimeSeriesSplit, GroupKFold, and LOOCV.
Temporal data absolutely requires TimeSeriesSplit to prevent future leakage.
admissibility_notes: TimeSeriesSplit and GroupKFold are hard requirements, not suggestions.
escalation_conditions: Escalate when group membership overlaps between entities.
uncertainty_notes: LOOCV has high variance despite low bias for small n.

audit.rationale: Deterministic model selection heuristics derived from the Gemini deep research survey on scikit-learn best practices.
audit.dejargonized_summary: These are the decision rules that look at measurable properties of a dataset and pick which prediction method, error measure, data cleanup steps, and testing strategy to use without human judgment.
uncertainty_notes: Thresholds are empirically motivated but may require domain-specific calibration.

references.title: Decision Heuristics for Deterministic Model Selection in scikit-learn
references.note: heuristics.pdf research document driving all threshold selections.
